title: Differentiation of i3LMNS
author: Michael S. Fernandopulle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5tng6me

steps.title: Prepare iPSC culture
steps.instruction: Grow hNIL‑iPSC to ~80 % confluence; use ~2 wells of a 6‑well plate (≈10‑cm dish equivalent) as starting material; seed at lower density on day 0 because cells will be plated in E8 before switching to IM on day 1.

steps.title: EDTA split cells
steps.instruction: Perform an EDTA split as in Basic Protocol 1: without aspirating the EDTA, tilt the plate, add 3 mL DMEM/F12 to each well with a 10‑mL pipette, detach cells, gently triturate 2–3 times per well, then rock and swirl the plate by hand to resuspend and collect debris.

steps.title: Add induction medium
steps.instruction: Add 12 mL freshly prepared IM containing 10 µM Y‑27632 ROCK inhibitor, 2 µg mL⁻¹ doxycycline, and Compound E at 1 : 10 000 (from stock) to the dish.

steps.title: Inspect early differentiation
steps.instruction: Observe cells under an inverted microscope; they should begin to spread and form processes within 24 h of doxycycline treatment.

steps.title: Optional long‑term coating
steps.instruction: If long‑term culture is desired, coat new plates overnight with poly‑L‑ornithine (PLO), poly‑D‑lysine (PDL), or polyethylenimine (PEI) as described in Basic Protocol 8.

steps.title: Accutase dissociation
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL Accutase per 10‑cm dish to digest cells (see Basic Protocol 1).

steps.title: Quench and strain cells
steps.instruction: Tilt the plate, add 6 mL PBS to the Accutase‑cell mixture using a 10‑mL pipette, gently triturate 4–5 times, pass the suspension through a 40‑µm cell strainer, then add 1 mL IM to improve pelleting.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension for 5 min at room temperature (speed not specified).

steps.title: Choose replating or freezing
steps.instruction: Either re‑plate cells immediately (see Basic Protocol 8) or freeze for later use (see Basic Protocol 1). For freezing, dilute to 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ in IM containing 10 % DMSO.

steps.title: Incubate for colony detachment
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell pellet at room temperature for 10–15 min until colonies begin to detach.

steps.title: Transfer cells to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.5 × 10⁶ iPSCs per 10‑cm dish into a 15‑mL conical tube.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Plate in E8 + ROCK
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 12 mL E8 medium supplemented with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor and plate onto a 10‑cm Matrigel‑coated dish.

steps.title: PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the plated cells once with PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend in IM
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 5 mL IM.
